description_en: Queries the statistics on the resources in an account group by resource type
description_zh: 从资源类型维度查询指定账号组内资源的统计结果
kebab_example: aliyun config get-aggregate-resource-counts-group-by-resource-type --biz-region cn-hangzhou --aggregator-id ca-a260626622af00050000 --folder-id r-BU0000 --resource-account-id 1009318965420000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAggregateResourceCountsGroupByResourceType
